title: A Choir for the Winter
author: Petra Kavanagh
blurb: Orsen Halloran, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must finish the ritual the founders started before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
